view.scene_description: A modern, spacious interior with large windows letting in bright daylight. A spiral bookshelf stands near the center-left, while a large digital screen displays an image on the right wall. Orange chairs and tables are arranged for seating. Stairs ascend to the right, and decorative lighting fixtures hang from the ceiling.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical bookshelf with multiple circular shelves spiraling upward. It is positioned near the left side of the room, partially illuminated by internal lights. Books are visible on its shelves. It stands on a polished floor and is adjacent to large windows.

objects.label: large digital screen
objects.observation: A large rectangular screen mounted on the wall, displaying a close-up image of a person's face. It is located on the right side of the room, below a purple-lit ceiling section. The screen is framed by wooden shelving units on either side.

objects.label: orange chairs
objects.observation: Multiple orange upholstered chairs with curved backs and metal bases are scattered throughout the room. They are grouped around tables and appear to be for seating. Some are in the foreground, others behind them, creating depth.

objects.label: tables
objects.observation: Several round tables with dark surfaces are placed among the chairs. They are positioned for use, some near the central area and others closer to the walls. Their legs are not clearly visible due to perspective and occlusion.

objects.label: stairs
objects.observation: A set of wide, yellow-lit stairs ascends to the right side of the room. They are made of wood or a similar material and lead to an upper level. The steps are illuminated from within, casting a warm glow.

objects.label: ceiling light fixture
objects.observation: A large, curved, textured light fixture hangs from the ceiling on the top left. It emits a soft glow and has a patterned surface. It is suspended from the ceiling by unseen means and illuminates the space above the spiral bookshelf.

objects.label: large windows
objects.observation: Tall, expansive windows span the left wall, allowing natural light to flood the room. They offer a view of the outside, though details are obscured by brightness. The frames are slim and modern, contributing to the open feel of the space.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000039", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
